interpretation: RF completeness is not citation recall.
Bootstrap preserves all rows from a sampled task and averages completed answer scores; it does not restore planned failed responses or task parity.
Three purposeful tasks give highly discrete descriptive intervals; no hypothesis, human agreement or rating correctness is proven.
V1 source failures remain historical records; v2 makes newly accessible exact URLs explicit.
Whole-answer segmentation treats factual P2 quotes as claims, while P3 supporting excerpts are proof only.
Prompt/collection defects and corrected transcripts belong in a separate collection-integrity audit.
